status_notes.Maincode: Already validated by the shared logo operation in the demo workspace.
status_notes.Kraken: First-party site links its icon as metadata and renders its navigation wordmark inline. The public recruiting board is ineligible as a branding page and its theme image exceeds the pixel cap.
status_notes.Easygo: First-party career page declares SVG with a Sanity CDN host. Its available raster rendition is absent from the exact image or Organization declarations.
status_notes.PALO IT: Official page declares SVG and its embedded raster URL uses an unsupported name query parameter.
status_notes.Airwallex: The global operating-principles page declares a raster exceeding the decoded size limit. The smaller Help Centre wordmark uses an unsupported media type.
status_notes.NVIDIA: The official brand guideline embeds SVG. Newsroom raster is on an external asset host outside supported exact image verification. The NVIDIA Developer page declares a raster under the developer portal name.
status_notes.Amazon: The official press logo artwork is provided on a separate asset host without matched Organization metadata or a named header image.
status_notes.EPAM Systems: Official mark is SVG. Its PNG app icon is labelled favicon.
status_notes.Encora: The branded Greenhouse board does not show an employer logo and the corporate domain redirects to Coforge.
